subject: Briarwood onsite travel extension — need to reschedule Jan kickoff demo

From: Caroline Ruiz <caroline.ruiz@briarwoodhealth.com>

Cc: Tim Hargrove <tim.hargrove@briarwoodhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Jan 5 kickoff demo — travel extension

Hi Karthik,

Quick update from our side — the week of Jan 4 we have an unexpected change: several members of our IT and data governance team are moving their site visit by a week (they tied it to a field event that got extended). That means our original Jan 5 slot for the kickoff demo will no longer work for the majority of stakeholders.

Can we please move the demo to the following week? Our preferred windows are: Jan 11 or Jan 12, mornings only (09:00–11:30 PT). If you can't make those windows, we'd appreciate a recording of the walkthrough and a short live Q&A with Anil (CTO) and Tim.

Also — we'll need the most recent kickoff deck and a copy of the security questionnaire you referenced earlier. If you can circulate the deck and a calendar invite with proposed times, that would be great.

Thank you,

Caroline Ruiz
Senior Program Manager, Briarwood Health
caroline.ruiz@briarwoodhealth.com

Subject: Re: Jan 5 kickoff demo — travel extension

Hi Caroline — thanks for the heads up and for the calendar snippet. Totally understand — thanks for flagging the stakeholder availability.

I pulled the latest kickoff deck and attached it (BRW-kickoff-deck-v2.pdf). We can absolutely accommodate Jan 11 or Jan 12 mornings. Two options that typically work well for rooms with mixed stakeholder availability:

- Option A (single session): 60-minute walkthrough + 15-minute live Q&A — suggested start 09:00 PT
- Option B (split): 30-minute executive/high-level demo (09:00 PT) + 30-minute deep-dive with Anil/IT (10:00 PT) — we record both segments so anyone who misses can catch up

Please confirm which option you prefer and which date (Jan 11 or Jan 12). I've attached a link to my open slots if you'd rather pick a time directly: https://cal.redwood.com/karthik/book?slot=avail

If you're short on time, we can record the session and I can hand the live walkthrough to Monica from CS for the Jan 11/12 session. Monica knows the onboarding & integrations playbook and can handle the security/cert questions live.

I'll hold Jan 11 morning tentatively until I hear back.

Cheers,

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Karthik / Monica — quick note. Karthik, thanks for the update and for prepping the deck. Karthik, please confirm your availability Jan 11–12; if you're already committed to travel or another onsite, please hand this to Monica to own the live demo on those dates. Monica — please stand by to lead the Jan 11/12 morning session if Karthik is unavailable. I'll loop in solutions-engineering if deep kernel/latency questions come up.

Logistics: Monica, if you take the session, please use the split option (Option B) — exec demo plus technical deep-dive — and record both. Also cross-post the recorded links to the HubSpot deal BRW-2345 after the session. If contracts conversation starts, I'll assist with any one-time terms.

Thanks,

Thanks, Lauren & team — appreciate the quick coordination. Jan 12 at 09:00 PT works best for our group (we have a site wrap on the 11th that will still be running late). Monica — welcome and look forward to seeing you. We agree to the split approach: brief exec overview then technical deep-dive.

Action items from our side: I'll send a calendar invite for Jan 12 09:00 PT and add Anil + Tim. Please send the security questionnaire and any compliance artifacts you can share ahead of time (SOC 2 attestation, data flow diagram). We'll also circulate a short internal redlines doc for the contract; please route any DocuSign envelopes to contracts@briarwoodhealth.com.

If it helps, I've created a quick HubSpot note on the deal (BRW-2345) summarizing the reschedule.

Best,

Caroline
